appearance.textSizeHint: Scale text throughout the app on this device without changing spacing or control sizes. Changes apply immediately.
appearance.textPreview: A conversation that is easy to read
appearance.textPreviewBody: Messages, menus and settings follow your chosen text size.
appearance.textPreviewCaption: Smaller labels keep their visual hierarchy.
appearance.compactPreviewsHint: Collapse link, image, GIF and video previews into compact rows. Tap a row to expand it. Full previews are shown by default.
appearance.languageHint: Your device language is selected on first launch. A language chosen here is saved on this device.
appearance.accentHint: Choose a color that highlights buttons, links, and active elements.
appearance.translateHint: Default target language for translated messages. Leave on Auto to pick per message.

install.desktopBanner: Use Jablu for Windows for native calls, screen sharing and tray notifications.
install.pwaBanner: Install Jablu for quick access and an app-like experience.
install.installed: You are using an installed app, or your browser reports Jablu is installed.
install.intro: Install the web app for quick access and a separate app window. On macOS, Safari's Add to Dock is recommended; Chrome and Edge also support installation.
install.detectionHint: Installation detection depends on the browser. Some browsers cannot detect an app installed outside the current window.
install.nativeDetectionHint: A website cannot reliably detect an existing Windows desktop installation. Downloading a file is not treated as installation.
install.failed: Installation could not be started. Try your browser's install menu instead.
install.preferencesError: Could not save your installation prompt preference.
install.desktopHint: The Windows app supports native calls, screen sharing and system tray notifications.
install.downloadError: Desktop downloads could not be loaded.
install.noDownload: No desktop download is currently available for this platform.

steps.ios1: Open the browser's Share menu. If Add to Home Screen is missing, open Jablu in Safari.
steps.ios3: Tap Add. Open Jablu using its new home-screen icon.
steps.safari1: On macOS Sonoma 14 or later, open Jablu in Safari and choose File → Add to Dock.
steps.safari2: Confirm the name and click Add.
steps.safari3: Open Jablu from the Dock or Applications.
steps.chrome1: Use the install icon in the address bar, or the browser menu's install option.
steps.chrome3: Jablu opens in its own app window.
steps.android2: Choose Add to Home screen or Install app, then confirm.
steps.android3: Open Jablu using its new home-screen icon.
steps.edge1: Open Edge's menu and choose Apps.
steps.edge2: Choose Install this site as an app and confirm.
steps.edgeMobile2: Choose Add to phone or Install app and confirm.
steps.firefoxDesktop: Installation support depends on your Firefox version and operating system. If no install option is available, use Safari on macOS or Chrome/Edge.
steps.firefoxAndroid1: Open Firefox's menu, choose Install, and confirm Add.
steps.samsung1: Open Samsung Internet's menu and choose Add page to → Home screen.
steps.generic: Look for Install app or Add to Home Screen in your browser's menu. If unavailable, use Chrome, Edge, or Safari.

activity.intro: Activity Status lets people see the games you play and the music you listen to. Detection runs only on the desktop app and nothing is shared unless you turn it on here.
activity.shareDescription: Display your current game or music to friends and servers.
activity.gamesDescription: Share the games you are currently playing.
activity.musicDescription: Share the track you are listening to on Spotify.
activity.friendsAllDescription: Share your activity with friends and everyone in every server you are in.
activity.friendsSmallDescription: Share with friends and members of smaller servers only.
activity.friendsOnlyDescription: Only your friends can see what you are playing or listening to.
activity.perServerDescription: Turn a server off to hide your activity from its members. Your friends can still see it.
activity.perServerEmpty: You are not in any servers yet.
activity.onlineLabel: Notify friends when I come online
activity.onlineDescription: Let your friends know when you start using the app.

games.intro: These are the games and apps we've detected while you use your computer. Hide any you don't want to share, or add one we missed. To make a custom app detectable, add its executable name (e.g. game.exe) — leave it blank for a name-only entry. Activity is only shared when Activity Status is turned on.
games.empty: No games yet. Play something with the desktop app open and it'll show up here.
